overview: Travel beyond Skyrim to explore Bruma, the northernmost county in Cyrodiil. Delve into Ayleid ruins, meddle in local affairs or explore the wild. The mod features all new dungeons and secrets, many quests and storylines.

howTo.text: In order to start this mod you need to cross the border; you must either convince the Imperial guard outside the gate at Pale Pass, south of Helgen, to let you through or find your way through Serpent's Trail Cave; you can also use a secret passage in Gromm's Pass or the one in Rielle Crypt.

notes.text: You won't be allowed passage through the gate unless you are sided with the Imperial Legion or are recognized as having accomplished some great deed (such as becoming Harbringer of the Companions or fullfilling your duty as the Dragonborn); alternatively you can kill the guards or use an alternate route (Serpent's Trail or Gromm's Pass). [\\n]Once you get to Cyrodiil, the border gates will be open from either side.

creator: BeyondSkyrimDC

overview: In the east of High Rock, in the land known as The Reach, despair curses Arnima and its people. Explore a vast new land and experience a new original story.

howTo.text: In order to start this mod talk with the priestess of Mara and her bodyguard in any major Skyrim city (they will come to you once you meet the requirements).

creator: razorkid1

overview: Become a new recruit for the Vigilants of Stendarr and experience a Dark Souls style story. The mod incudes a lenghty main quest divided in 4 acts across Skyrim and Coldharbour; your choices will decide your fate.

howTo.text: In order to start this mod speak with Altano in Windpeak Inn.

where.desc: Windpeak Inn in Dawnstar.

notes.text: This mod is best to be played without followers. It's highly recommended to be at least level 40 when starting the story; Dawnbreaker can be particularly useful. The mod introduces the Karma mechanic related to your actions and will influence how the story goes. It's the first part of Vicn's Trilogy. The mod introduces MANY new conjuration spells. The Nails of St. Dulsa will grant a Perk Point; other alchemy items will also increase your attributes and carry weight permanently.

creator: Vicn

overview: Join the witch hunters in the second part of Vicn's trilogy; fend off a curse and fight nightmarish creatures. The mod takes inspiration from Bloodborne and Dark Souls.

howTo.text: Talk to the orphan Lalanoah at the gate of Falkreath.

notes.text: This mod is a sequel to Vigilant and prequel to Unslaad. The mod introduces firearms and a custom skill tree; you can buy firearms by an NPC north-weast of Falkreath in Roadside Ruins as soon as you meet the level requirements for the mod. Glenmoril is currently incomplete (Act IV is in development).

creator: Vicn

overview: Travel though time and help a Half-Dragon in this 4 acts quest mod.

howTo.text: Interact with the doll on the edge of a cliff in High Hrothgar.

where.desc: The mod concludes the trilogy of Vigilant and Glenmoril. A new mechanic introduced allows to convert Dragon Souls into perks and other upgrades.
where.title: Notes

creator: Vicn

overview: The Champion of Cyrodiil was the last known to have claimed the Gray Cowl of Nocturnal at the end of the Third Era, but now it's calling for a new owner. You will explore the Alik'r Desert and other mysterious places to follow the call.

howTo.text: In order to begin the mod you will need to steal or pickpocket something; after that you will experience a vision that triggers The Call of the Gray Cowl quest.

where.desc: Anywhere where there is something to steal.

notes.text: The mod is focused around stealth gameplay and puzzles, but doesn't force any playstile. The Remnants of Hammerfell also take place in the Alik'r Desert. Another quest bundle further expands the exploration of Hammerfell.[\\n]The mod introduces various artifacts with enchantments useful to locate valuables, chests and people.

creator: MannyGT

req.misc: have completed the Way of the Voice

quest.initial: The Call of the Gray Cowl of Nocturnal

overview: After helping the Remnants in the Redguard Elite Armaments quest you can find them again in Hammerfell and help them once more dealing with the Thalmor.

howTo.text: In order to start this mod speak with Boscean at the Remnant Tower west of the Watchtower in the Alik'r Desert (introduced by The Gray Cowl of Nocturnal Mod).

notes.text: Takes place in the same worldspace introduced by The Gray Cowl of Nocturnal. The required quest (Interception), starts in Skyrim by speaking with Azadi in Shor's Stone.

creator: Betalille

req.misc: have completed Interception from Redguard Elite Armaments (Creation Club)

overview: Travel to the island of Falskaar where conflict is brewing and the presence of a true hero is required. The island is full of new dungeons, quests and people.

howTo.text: To start Falskaar, go to Riften and speak with Jalamar. He will either be outside around the market, inside the northern gate, or inside the Bee and Barb. You can also just go straight into Echo Deep Mine, a new dungeon just northeast of Riften and find a lexicon there.

notes.text: It's not recommended to start the mod too early in the playthrough since it could break the first cut-scene. New equipment and spells are not the focus of this mod, therefore not many were added.

creator: AlexanderJVelicky

overview: A dragon has been attacking the East Empre Company trade lanes; you are quested to rid of the dragon but things aren't so easy. You will travel to the Wyrmstooth island north of Solitude across the Sea of Ghosts.

howTo.text: An imperial courier named Theodyn Bienne will track you down starting from the Bannered Mare in Whiterun and direct you to speak with Lurius Liore.

where.desc: Bannered Mare in Whiterun.

notes.text: Requirements are customizable in the MCM.

creator: Jonx0r

req.misc: have completed the Way of the Voice

overview: North-west of Tamriel is the home of the Sunmer; Midwood Isle. Discover their culture, history and their troubles. A dark power menaces the island; will you save it?

howTo.text: A courier will deliver a letter to you asking you to come to the Frozen Hearth in Winterhold.

where.desc: Once you have met the requirements you can start the mod by going to the Frozen Hearth without needing to wait for the courier.
where.title: Notes

creator: Will Evans

req.misc: have completed the Way of the Voice

overview: Only the Khajiit know the secret paths of the moon that lead the followers of the Mane back to Elsweyr. Explore burning deserts, emerald jungles and cerulean skies and join the Khajit resistance as the Dragonborn and aid them in their fight.

howTo.text: Talk with the khajiit near Falkreath and ask to travel with them to Elsweyr OR (if you are at least lv.18 and have at least 70 displays in the museum) wait for Aurelyn (the curator of the Dragonborn Museum in Solitude) to task you with recovering the staff of Indarys; you will receive a letter to investigate a Khajiit caravan that will lead you to Elsweyr.

notes.text: The mod is bundled with the Legacy of the Dragonborn; if you have at least 70 displays in the Dragonborn Museum and are at least level 18, the curator will task you with recovering the staff of Indarys (This will start the quest "It Belongs in a Museum"); you will receive a letter to investigate a Khajiit caravan that will lead you to Elsweyr.[\\n]You don't have to wait until you meet these requirements; you are free to start the mod as soon as you complete The Way of the Voice.

creator: MuppetPuppet & An_Old_Sock

req.misc: have completed the Way of the Voice

quest.initial: By the Light of the Moon

overview: A day's sail in summertide from Winterhold; Olenveld, as described in "The Exodus", is the place Tiber Septim used as personal graveyard and fertile soil for necromancers.

howTo.text: In order to start the mod investigate the cabin north of Septimum Signus Outpost (north of Winterhold). You will have to interact with a note and use the map on the table to start the quest and go to Olenveld.

notes.text: It's recommended not to bring followers along since the mod uses cut-scenes and they may bug out due to followers.[\\n]The choice to have quest marker during your exploration is free.

creator: F0RCEFI3LD

overview: Completely overhauled and expanded the Saints & Seducers Creation. This mod will take you to the homeland of these two types of daedra: the daedric realm known as the Shvering Isles, the Asylum, The Realm Of Madness.

howTo.text: Once met the requirements either sleep for 6 hours or exit Solitude and come back later.

creator: ECSSDevGroup

req.misc: have completed The Mind of Madness

overview: Glendora Messenia, Gavo Antonius and Angarion the Bold are cursed to roam endlessly in the Soul Cairn; they need your help! Will you accompany them on their last voyage?

howTo.text: Progress the Dawnguard DLC questline until allowed entrace to the Soul Cairn. You will be able to start 3 new quests there.

notes.text: Siding with either the Volkihar clan or the Dawnguard will not influence this mod.

name.full: More to do in the Soul Cairn

creator: Betalille

req.misc: have progressed through the Dawnguard DLC questline

overview: Completely reworked the Reaper boss fight in the Soul Cairn. This fight is fully repeatable, with scaling difficulty, randomized enemies, and dozens of pieces of custom loot.

howTo.text: Collect the three Reaper Gem Fragments and place them on the altar in the Reaper's Lair.

where.desc: Soul Cairn.

notes.text: The fight can be repeated by activating the Deathless Shrine; each new fight yelds increasingly better (unique) rewards. You can reduce the difficulty of the fight by making an offering at the Well of Obols.

creator: SlimeSire

req.misc: have progressed through the Dawnguard DLC questline

overview: Do you remember in vanilla Skyrim when Belethor says that if he had a sister he'd sell her? Well you are not going to believe this...

howTo.text: Talk to Belethor at his store; Belethor's General Goods in Whiterun.

where.desc: The quest requires many NPCs of Whiterun to be alive (including Nazeem).
where.title: Notes

creator: wankingSkeever

req.misc: have completed Chasing Echoes

overview: Help an argonian cobbler secure a spot within Markarth's tradehouse. The tradehouse is a new addition of this mod; Fortune is the proprietor and you will have to complete some tasks for him.

howTo.text: Speak with Ut-Keen at the entance of the Fortune's Tradehouse in the northern part of Markarth, near the Understone Keep.

notes.text: The Tradehouse offers peculiar vendors, including ones specialized in fire, gems and books.

creator: DoubtSuspended

overview: Mzark, once ruler of everything under Skyrim's mountains, left behind wonders untouched for thousands of years, watched over by a group of strange sentient machines. Embark on an adveture to retrieve the lost wonders of Mzark!

howTo.text: Head to the northern sea; north of the wreck of the Brinehammer and Dawnstar you will find Mzarnumez to start the quest.

notes.text: It is recommended you be above level 25 before trying the mod, and also pay attention to the notes and your surroundings since most enemies have special ways of being defeated. [\\n]Do not exit the dialogue with the holograms until they are finished to prevent bugs in the quest.[\\n]The mod adds various dwemer staves.

creator: Trainwiz & DarthVitrial

overview: You and a team of divers are hired by the Black-Briars to investigate the depths of Lake Honrich but it won't be so easy. You will jump, climb, dive, solve puzzles and fight undead in a submerged Ayleid ruin.

howTo.text: Speak to Frissa Black-Briar at Elgrim's Elixirs in Riften.

where.desc: The explorable ruins are inspired to platforming exploration games; many sections require diving so prepare accordingly.
where.title: Notes

creator: Everglaid

overview: Embark on a journey to retreive the mighty Keening, Sunder and Wraithguard; the artifacts forged by Lord Kagrenac in his attempt to bend the power of the Heart of Lorkhan to the benefit of the Dwemer.

howTo.text: A couple of days after obtaining the Keening during Arniel's Endeavor you will receive a letter from a courier to start the quest; alternatively you can trigger the quest using the alternate start from the MCM. Visit the Wiki for more info.

notes.text: You need to have the Keening in your inventory for the quest (it will become a quest item); if the quest starts without the Keening becoming a quest item you can try to drop it and pick it up again then leave the location. When the Keening can't be dropped the quest has started successfully.[\\n]The mod introduces various race shapeshifting spells.

creator: Titansbane & PrivateEye

req.misc: have completed the Way of the Voice and Arniel's Endeavor

overview: You will be introduced to a hidden settlement of House Telvanni, Sadrith Kegran. The city is build on Dwemer Ruins and you will discover many of their inventions.

howTo.text: Head to the Braidwood Inn in Kynesgrove and talk to Iddra the innkeeper, she will have a note for you to investigate a suspicious orc at Mixwater Mill. Head south of Windhelm to find the Mill and talk to the orc to start the mod.

notes.text: The mod introduces Snippy a BB-8 (Star Wars) inspired Dwemer droid follower (more on the mod page) and the Aetherium Hyperspace Observatory (a mobile player house). Your followers will be dismissed at the beginning of the mod, however it is strongly recommended to dismiss any custom follower before starting the mod.

creator: Haem Projects

overview: Embark on an adventure for treasure, make unusual acquaintances and be tested with the trial of the Daedra. You will explore the Daedric realm of Periyte and the Faceted Stones, another smaller Oblivion realm, once inhabited by the Snow Elves, now belonging to the Goblin.

howTo.text: To begin the quest visit Abandoned Grotto near Hillgrund’s Tomb and Lost Knife Hideout and speak with the Khajiits.

notes.text: A FAQ section specific to this mod is available on the Tuxborn Wiki. [\\n]The mod introduces a peculiar follower: Imp; he won't leave you until you finish his quest. [\\n]A minimum level of 10 is recommended.

creator: Haem Projects

overview: Deep beneath the Throat of the World something dangerous is stirring; the Chronographers of Lull-Mor have no choice but to seek outside help to stop a mad mystic and his army from unmaking the very foundations of the world!

howTo.text: Travel to any open vanilla settlement (Big cities are excluded). A message will appear; go talk to the walking machine.

where.desc: Either Dawnstar, Dragon Bridge, Falkreath, Ivarstead, Karthwasten, Morthal, Riverwood, Rorikstead, Shor's Stone or Winterhold.

notes.text: The mod author recommends playing this after The Lost Wonders of Mzark. The mod is best experienced without followers for both immersion and stability purposes. The various stages of the questline have progressively higher level requirements: 20-25-30-35. A MCM is avalaible to tweak some parameters and level requirements. The mod introduces haquebuses, a type of gun (treated similarly to a crossbow).

creator: Trainwiz, DarthVitrial & themayor897

overview: A chance encounter in the wilds of Skyrim sets you on the path to the abandoned Clockwork Castle; built by a very successful merchant family from faraway High Rock, the castle is filled with Dwemer technology, but what happened to the owners?

howTo.text: Once level 5, you will be attacked by a NPC carrying a letter from one "Camilla".

notes.text: You won't be able to leave the place until the quest is finished! It's recommended to dismiss all your followers before starting the mod.

creator: Antistar

overview: Help rebuild Helgen! You'll reunite two old friends, uncover an underground slavery ring, battle in an arena and take part in many other adventures!

howTo.text: A courier will deliver you a book to start the mod.

where.desc: Anywhere or technically Helgen.

notes.text: A MCM is avalaible to tweak the starting requirements.

creator: Mike Hancho

req.misc: have completed Bleak Falls Barrow

overview: Discover secrets, mysteries, and relics that are thousands of years old while solving a murder mystery in an ancient underground city. It has a dark, non-linear story in which you'll interrogate suspects, explore the city and its many secrets, and navigate challenging moral dilemmas.

howTo.text: A courier will approach you in a city once you meet the requirements. Alternatively, you can make your way to the Forgotten Ruins yourself.

where.desc: Forgotten Ruins in the south-west corner of Skyrim.

notes.text: The Forgotten City is the first mod in history to win a national Writers' Guild award with its script. Best experienced without followers.

creator: Nick Pearce

overview: Travel to an isolated island, earn the loyalty of your 9 companions, stop a daedric lord from returning to power, and close shut the jaws of Oblivion once more!

howTo.text: Visit any major vanilla city to begin the first quest after meeting the requirements.

where.desc: The mod exploration system is inspired by Mass Effect (you will always have 3 companions with you).
where.title: Other

notes.text: You won't be able to leave the place until the main quest is finished! It's recommended to dismiss all your followers before starting the mod. [\\n]Your companions' quest will fail if not completed before a certain point of no-return in the main questline (you will be warned of this in-game too).[\\n]All 5 vanilla bugs in a jar (displayables) are available at Snowdrift Estate.

creator: TheBawb

req.misc: have completed the Way of the Voice and killed the Dragonborn DLC's cultists

overview: A mysterious and powerful criminal has been spotted in Skyrim, his trail dogged by hunters from Morrowind. However, there may be more at stake than it seems, and this criminal may be familiar...

howTo.text: A courier may give you a letter the next time you fast travel to an outdoor area. Otherwise, you can go to the Sleeping Giant Inn in Riverwood and find Mandyn Hlaalu.

notes.text: Lucien has special dialogue for this mod. It's recommended to start this mod on a higher level (30+).

creator: Gan Xingba

req.misc: have completed the Way of the Voice and killed the Dragonborn DLC's cultists

overview: When a powerful necromancer and his followers seek out the forbidden secrets of immortality that could threaten Skyrim, will you defeat him to stop his evil quest, or continue it yourself?

howTo.text: The mod starts with a note left behind by a traveler that will spawn at Markarth's Silver-Blood Inn.

where.desc: Between Riften and Ivarstead

notes.text: The Necromantic Altars require a skill level of 50 in Enchanting and 75 in Conjuration (configurable through MCM). Consult the nexus mod page of Undeath - Classical Lichdom for more info on the Lich form and mechanics.

creator: Antioch08

overview: Take up the mantle of Meridia's Champion, and work with Meridia's Order to destroy a threat of Necromantic Tyranny in this new adventure! Will you bring back Meridia's Order from its breaking point?

howTo.text: After meeting the requirements, wait in any major city to be greeted by one of Meridia's Order's Paladins, or travel to the Sanctum yourself and speak with High Priestess Alara.

where.desc: The Sanctum is located near Rimerock Burrow, far west of Solitude.

notes.text: Some quest rewards can be disenchanted to learn powerful new enchantments.[\\n]Once all side quests are completed you will be able to improve Meridia's gifts.

creator: TheOscar0

req.misc: have completed the Break of Dawn

overview: Discover the north's most fearsome warriors: the berserkers. Encounter new enemies, armors, and quests, and receive the power to transform into a werebear.

howTo.text: Talk to the man looking for a mercenary at the Four Shield Tavern.

where.desc: Four Shield Tavern in Dragonbridge south of Solitude.

notes.text: Depending on your choices during the questline, you will be able to become a Berserker (Werebear). The Berserker transforms when their Health becomes low; alternatively, they can trasform by eating a Bear's Paw. Berserkers retain many features of Werewolves, but are not granted a Beast Form power and have a different Perk Tree.

creator: JPSteel2

overview: The player will be tasked to help an aspiring artist who seeks to create his magnum opus. A simple premise with frightening implications.

howTo.text: Find Vane at his cabin east of Rorikstead and speak to him.

notes.text: The story takes inspiration from H.P. Lovecraft's work. There are no quest markers. After your first encounter with Vane you will need to wait a couple of days for the story to progress.

creator: nimwraith

overview: Mysteries of the Dwemer centres around Maro, a researcher of the Dwemer who will help explain various parts of their convoluted lore to the player.

howTo.text: You can first encounter Maro in the way up to Mzulft. Subsequently he will show up near Bthardamz, Alftand and finally Avanchnzel.

notes.text: There are no quest markers for this mod.

creator: nimwraith

overview: A mysterious entity resides within a large underwater cavern. Your goal is to uncover what the creature is and how it can be stopped. This will be done with the help of Manias, a researcher of the paranormal.

howTo.text: Investigate the submerged cave north of Yngvild, near Dawnstar.

notes.text: Tuxborn currently runs an old version of The Breathing Abyss; this version is different in some aspects and the mod page has been hidden on Nexus.

creator: nimwraith

overview: A spirit wanders Skyrim searching for those responsible for his killing, hoping that avenging his and a loved one's deaths will return him to the afterlife.

howTo.text: Speak to the ghost near Morthal; the subsequent quest locations are not marked, but can be deduced from the dialogue.

creator: nimwraith

overview: Improved the vanilla random encounter of the Old Orc by giving him new motivations along with adding in a new unique armour set for the Orc to wear.

howTo.text: It's a random world encounter.

creator: nimwraith

overview: See Skyrim like you never did before and challenge yourself to get to its many peaks! A total of 5 mountains in Skyrim plus 4 in Solstheim are now climbable!

howTo.text: In order to climb one of the 9 hidden peaks you will need to find them first, but if you don't like the idea, the mod page lists all the peaks.

notes.text: Cairns are used to mark the start of the climb; use the wind to help you find the path.[\\n]Each climb you manage will grant an elemental resistance buff under some circumstances.

creator: jayserpa

overview: Meet a hooded stranger who will begin to discuss his beliefs in life and how it should be experienced.

howTo.text: Speak to the hooded man on the steps to High Hrothgar, right before the IX tablet.

creator: nimwraith

overview: The Sloads were made to be nearly extinct, however, many remained, and their numbers have grown since The Second Era.  Join Talhik and his crew on a quest to an island to slay Sloads!

howTo.text: Speak with the Redguard Talhik in Solitude; you can find him at his ship near Solitude Lighthouse or at the Winking Skeever during the late hours. [\\n]Once you find the ship, you can either use fast travel or activate the smaller ship on the shore nearby to get on board.[\\n][\\n][\\n]

notes.text: It's recommended to experience the mod without followers or at least not have them with you during the first travel to the new worldspace.[\\n]The mod is a prologue to a larger unreleased project involving Thras, as such it may feel incomplete at the moment.

creator: Zediious

overview: A mysterious old Nordic legend tells of Orkey, walking shadows, and the death of an old priestess countless centuries ago. At the heart of it all, the strange realm of Gravewind; will you survive to the end?

howTo.text: Travel northwest of the Roadside Ruins in Falkreath, and enter the abandoned homestead.

notes.text: You won't be able to exit the place after the mod starts. The mod introduces three new forms of magic. Level 25+ recommended.[\\n]Once you have completed the quest, return to Gravewind to grab the spells: they will be in the throne room and in the boss arenas. [\\n]Depending on which ending you chose you will get different rewards.

creator: runesentinel

overview: A woman got lost while sleepwalking; her husband tasks you with finding her. She seems to suffer from some night terrors, but surely that's not relevant... also, no Daedric Prince is involved here for sure...

howTo.text: Speak with Ralforn in green-tip cabin, north-east of Ivarstead, who will ask you for help to find his wife, Gretska.

notes.text: Some steps of the mod don't have quest markers. You will get a different reward at the end of the quest depending on the ending you get.[\\n]The names of some keys are swapped.[\\n]The mod introduces sleep related spells and bows and day/night related equipment.

creator: TheLootist

overview: The story is focused entirely on Daumbra: the newest incarnation of the cursed sword Umbra. She can be your follower, but she can also be your weapon or neither.

howTo.text: In order to start the main questline of the mod you must read the book There is No Umbra; you can find it in common loot or on Farengar's desk. The quest has a known issue described in the wiki.

where.desc: The book can be easily found on Farengar's desk in Dragonsreach (Whiterun).
where.title: Book's Location

notes.text: You will obtain a new Follower: Daumbra. This is no ordinary follower (it's a floating sword); you can find out more details on the mod page or discover everything by playing.[\\n]You may need to progress in A Daedra's Best Friend and Blood on the Ice quests to reach certain objectives in the questline.

creator: FableForge

overview: After the banishing of the World Eater, an order of knight paladins was tasked to give their lives to keep the blade forged by Akatosh away from the wrong hands, but some thought differently...

howTo.text: In order to start the mod you must read the book The Grand Paladin. You can find the book at the Bards College or in Skaal's Village Greathall or lastly in The Arcaneum at the College of Winterhold.

notes.text: The mod is designed for high level characters playing as the Dragonborn; 600+ Health is advised.[\\n]Visit the mod page on Nexus for information about the reward weapon's enchantment.

creator: Kittytail

req.misc: have completed Dragon Rising

overview: Delve in darkness and experience the gloomy atmosphere of the island of Pharos; fight new enemies and discover an Ancient set of weapons of incredible power.

howTo.text: Travel to Voyager's end, the final resting place of a foreign ship, wrecked long ago on the Sea of Ghost, Northwest of Winterhold; within the ship you find the way to the island.

notes.text: There are no quest markers (or quests) in the mod. It's recommended to leave your followers behind and also be at least level 15.

creator: JKrojmal

overview: Journey in the footsteps of a group of mercenaries in search of a powerful ring known in the possession of a necromancer who took possession of the abandoned Fort Icemoth.

howTo.text: Reach the Old Wooden Jetty, west from Northwatch Keep to the most north-western beach in Skyrim, and read the waterlogged journal in the dead mercenary's inventory.

notes.text: The mod adds a book (Fort Icemoth: A Mercenary's Diary) that will add a pointer to the Old Wooden Jetty on the map. You can find the book as random loot or look for it in Dragonsreach.[\\n]Some areas and dungeon can only be accessed by diving underwater.

creator: RoastGorilla439

overview: Explore hidden Dwemer ruins in Blackreach, find new spells and fend off dark apparitions across The Reach.

howTo.text: Head to Deep Folk Crossing noth of Markarth and investigate the aftermath of a skirmish. You will need to read a note found on a dead body to start the quest.

notes.text: The mod adds Lingering Void Energy spots across the Reach (and Blackreach) with associated treasure chests; 4 of them will drop Dwemer Tonal Glyphs that give passive bonuses while worn, without using equipment slots.[\\n]The mod introduces a themed spell pack whose spell tomes are obtineable at a smelter by using the Pieces of Void dropped by the void apparitions and as a rare drop from said apparitions.

creator: Kittytail

overview: Delve into the depths of an underground swamp in the aid of a priest in order to heal the Heart of the Reach.

howTo.text: To start the mod you will need to talk to an NPC named Gwilym at the Silver Blood Inn located in Markarth.

creator: TheLootist

overview: Adds an accessible sewer system to the town of Solitude, Whiterun, Windhelm and Markarth and also small sewage tunnels to Fort Sungard and Greenwall.

howTo.text: Open the sewers from one of its entances and explore.

where.desc: Solitude, Whiterun,  Windhelm, Markarth, Fort Sungard or Fort Greenwall.

creator: Viltuska

overview: Uncover the secret history of the College of Winterhold and delve in the greatly expanded Midden.

howTo.text: You can access the mod's content by exploring the Midden; most of it is behind puzzles and hidden passages, but you can find more info on the mod page if you can't solve it yourself. The initial quest is named "The Black Library" and starts as soon as you enter the secret store room in the Midden.

where.desc: There are three entrances to the Midden: a trapdoor in the northern corner of the College courtyard, another trapdoor at the base of the stairwell in the Hall of Countenance, and a cave in the northern face of the rocky outcropping that the College rests upon.

notes.text: The hatchery in the Arcane Grotto (new player home) resets and is NOT safe for storage.[\\n]You will learn a spell that teleports you to the custom player home from anywhere.[\\n]Completing the quest about the home you will be able to trasmute iron ore into gold.

creator: EasierRider

overview: A narrative-focused adventure in a large spriggan cave / Nord temple from Easier Rider's Dungeon Pack where players must choose a side in the fight between the spirits of nature and the forces of evil.

howTo.text: Enter the large spriggan cave / Nord temple north of Robber's Gorge. [\\n]Alternatively, read Legends of Grimroot Hollow to add the dungeon marker to your map; you can find the book at the Temple of Kynareth in Whiterun or at Karthspire Camp.

creator: EasierRider

overview: A large, haunted Blades outpost north of Markarth from Easier Rider's Dungeon Pack.

howTo.text: North of Markarth. [\\n]Alternatively, read The Two Stones to add the dungeon marker to your map; you can find the book at the Karthspire Redoubt and in Delphine's basement at the Sleeping Giant Inn in Riverwood.

notes.text: Beware of every place you may fall and spikes since it will force your death or leave you stuck due to Shades of Mortality.
notes.title: Warning

creator: EasierRider

overview: A small sea cave west of Broken Oar Grotto from Easier Rider's Dungeon Pack.

howTo.text: Enter the sea cave west of Broken Oar Grotto, near Solitude. [\\n]Alternatively, read Urik the Red to add the dungeon marker to your map; you can find the book at the Wreck of the Brinehammer and at the Wreck of the Winter War.

creator: EasierRider

overview: A large, bandit-infested mine south of Falkreath from Easier Rider's Dungeon Pack.

howTo.text: Enter the mine south of Falkreath. [\\n]Alternatively, read the The Pit of Strife to add the dungeon marker to your map; you can find it in Bilegulch Mine and in Left Hand Mine.

creator: EasierRider

overview: A large, Nord ruin northeast of Windhelm from Easier Rider's Dungeon Pack.

howTo.text: Enter the Nord ruin northeast of Windhelm. [\\n]Alternatively, read the Old Intelligence Report to add the dungeon marker to your map; you can find it at Castle Dour and at the Palace of Kings.

notes.text: Beware of the lava: some areas are filled with lava that is supposed to kill you on the spot, but you will remain stuck there due to Shades of Mortality; it's recommended to save before entering.
notes.title: Warning

creator: EasierRider

overview: A large Giant cavern, located beneath Stonehill Bluff from Easier Rider's Dungeon Pack.

howTo.text: Enter the cavern beneath Stonehill Bluff, south-east of Morthal. [\\n]Alternatively, read the book A Giant's Slayer's Guide to Giantology to add the dungeon marker to your map; you can find the book at Halted Stream Camp and in Jorrvaskr Living Quarters.

creator: EasierRider

overview: A small Orcish shrine/burial cave near Avanchnzel from Easier Rider's Dungeon Pack.

howTo.text: Enter the cave near Avanchnzel in the Rift.[\\n]Alternatively, read the Farewell Note to add the dungeon marker to your map; you can find the note at Mauhulakh's Longhouse in Narzulbur and at Burguk's Longhouse in Dushnikh Yal.

creator: EasierRider

overview: A medium-sized hard necromancer cave near Steamcrag Camp from Easier Rider's Dungeon Pack.

howTo.text: Enter the cave near Steamcrag Camp in the Eastmarch.[\\n]Alternatively, read the book Life on the Edge to add the dungeon marker to your map; you can find the book at the White Phial in Windhelm or Arcadia's Cauldron in Whiterun.

creator: EasierRider

overview: The barrow outside Morthal once served as Hall of the Dead but has been abandoned for centuries; now the ancient dead have grown a habit of getting up and walking around.

howTo.text: Find the barrow south east of Morthal. Within the barrow search for a journal to start the main questline.

creator: Penrutet

overview: At the northmost clime of Tamriel, shrouded by fog and buried in ice, the Northern Asylum of Julianos quietly awaits you... Investigate the madness afflicting the Asylum and earn the boon of the Madgod himself.

howTo.text: Reach the Abandoned Stable east of Windhelm along the way to Traitor's Post and take a seat on the bench. You will have to reach the Asylum afterwards.

notes.text: The mod introduces the Seeds of Unreason: a custom home. The mod also introduces a couple of artifacts and a spell. There are no quest markers after the main one to obtain the house: you will need to explore and find the remaining items on your own.

creator: SlimeSire

overview: In the depths of the Ratway, a madman sorcerer has recently entered into a compact with Vaermina; venture into his nightmare and decide if such a place might serve a worthy domicile...

howTo.text: Make your way to the Riften ratways and find the entrance to the Underkeep (it's in the same area where you also access the Ragged Flagon and Shadowfoot Sanctum). Investigate the skeleton of Xiran's apprentice to begin your journey.

notes.text: The player home you obtain through the mod can be accessed at any time via spell. You can temporarily obtain a Fortify effect for any magic skill for the price of a filled Black Soul Gem if you have the Skull of Corruption.

creator: SlimeSire

overview: Beyond the desolate precincts of Winterhold, the remains of a temple once dedicated to the worship of Molag Bal lies dormant beneath the ice. Claim Krovaxis as your own and debase yourself in the name of your one true master!

howTo.text: Find your way to the Nameless Cavern to the northeast of Winterhold. The quest to find Krovaxis will automatically start once House of Horrors is completed.

notes.text: The player home in the mod gives infinite feeding opportunities to vampires. The house also comes with more unlockable features.

creator: SlimeSire

req.misc: have completed the House of Horrors

overview: Explore a world contained within the pages of a sorcerous text, and earn the favor of the Daedric Prince Hermaeus Mora.

howTo.text: Find and investigate the Derelict Shanty northeast of Solitude.

notes.text: The Annals is a vertical Apocrypha themed house; you will be able to summon them or teleport to the house at any time. If you have the Oghma Infinium you can get skill boosts to mage, warrior or thief skills. You need to give the Antiquarian some ruined books and paper scrolls to unlock all the upgrades and features.

creator: SlimeSire

overview: Take a journey through time in the lost Dragon Priest temple, Revakheim. Unlock unique gear and create armor not seen since the First Era. Fight ancient enemies and fulfill your destiny as the true "Konahrik" Warlord.

howTo.text: In order to start the quest head to Revakheim north of Anga's Mill, northwest of Windhelm, and find the Clay Mask within it.

notes.text: Reading The Dragon Forge, found in either Farengar's workshop or the College Arcaneum, will add the position of Revakheim to the map. The Clay Mask must be used in various areas of the dungeon in order to progress. The mod also adds various dragon priest related loot.

creator: Edhelsereg

req.misc: have acquired all dragon priests masks

overview: Dwemer spectres haunted ruins all across Vvardenfell forever guarding their puzzles and treasures. Yet, curiously, their presence was absent from Skyrim. NO MORE!

howTo.text: The various Specters are scattered across Dwemer Ruins. In order to start the big quest you will have to take down the 7 bosses across the various ruins and take their Cubes and the Unknown Contraption to Hrodulf's House in Solstheim. There, read the book.

where.desc: Hrodulf's House is in the southern part of Solstheim between Kolbjorn Barrow and Fort Frosmoth towards the shore.

creator: Trainwiz, DarthVitrial & TheMayor897

overview: Auriel is a Bosmer (Wood Elf) follower. She is a true traditionalist and a great archer. See the wiki or Nexus page for more info.

howTo.text: Find Auri at her Pod north west of Falkreath; you will be able to recruit her after a short talk.

creator: Waribiki

overview: Remiel is a breton dwemer-specialist follower; she will fight aided by her automaton Scrap and ask you to explore Dwemer ruins with her. See the wiki or Nexus page for more info.

howTo.text: In order to recruit Remiel you will need to explore Nchuanzel with her or tell her to "Snap out of it" to skip the initial quest.

where.desc: Find her at the Silver Blood Inn in Markarth.

notes.text: The initial quest dungeon also has a boss from Dwemer Specters which may pose a great obstacle for low leveled players; furthermoree, the boss is located exactly where a Remiel scripted scene starts, in order to prevent weird behaviour, it may be better to defeat the boss before bringing Remiel or skip the intro quest.

creator: Maplespice

overview: Inigo is an ex-skooma-addict Khajiit follower; he prefers archery, but any weapon will do. See the wiki or Nexus page for more info.

howTo.text: He can be found in Riften Jail in the first cell on your left. Riften Jail is below Mistveil Keep (Riften) on the right; you will have to bribe the guard to enter. Inigo will ramble about his past actions and finally will decide to follow you.

creator: Smartbluecat

overview: Xelzaz is an Argonian Lawman of House Telvanni follower; he mainly uses spells (summoning ones mostly) in battle. See the wiki or Nexus page for more info.

howTo.text: You can find Xelzaz by the Southern Morrowind Gate east of Dayspring Canyon and north east of Stendarr's Beacon.

creator: BluePwnsU

overview: Expands the character diversity with many new NPC integrated into the world, with a backstory and an extensive dialogue tree to explore.

howTo.text: Each NPC is integrated in the world; some have quests. See the Nexus page or the wiki page for more details, but beware Tuxborn runs the mod Quest Requirements Tweaks for Interesting NPCs.

creator: Kris Takahashi

overview: A colorful collection of armor sets from different mods, all retextured and integrated.
creator: Hothtrooper44

overview: Added a room for displays dedicated to Serana.
creator: Spacedroner

overview: Added a room for displays dedicated to Teldryn.
creator: Spacedroner

overview: The Curator's Companion is a useful addition to help you keep track of your displays in the Dragonborn Gallery.
creator: Ic0nIc0de

overview: The Dragonborn Museum will allow you store all those intiguing and definitely-not-dangerous artifacts very close together in many open-to-the-public displays! Go out and find something deadly to show the visitors!

howTo.text: In order to access the museum you will have to talk to the curator at the museum and complete 3 tasks for him. The museum also has its own questline that unlocks when you reach certain displays numbers. Check the wiki for more details.

creator: icecreamassassin

overview: Gore is a child-soldier grown adult with a deep backstory to explore; he fights mainly with two-handed weapons and uses heavy armour but will adapt to the equipment he is given. See the wiki or Nexus page for more info.

howTo.text: You can find Gore near Peak's Shade Tower east of Falkreath. He will follow you if you aid him.

creator: goredev

overview: Lucien is a scholar and will ask to accompany you while serving as his bodyguard; he will eventually get more confident and strong. Lucien has completely customizable combat system. See the wiki or Nexus page for more info.

howTo.text: You can find Lucien at Dead Man's Drink in Falkreath and recruit him right away.

where.desc: https://josephrussellauthor.com/Lucien.php
where.title: Lucien's Wiki

creator: Joseph Russell

overview: Completely overhauled Lydia follower interactions for a more immersive experience to match the circumstances she joins you in. See the wiki or Nexus page for more info.

howTo.text: Lydia is assigned as your housecarl as soon as you report back to the Jarl of Whiterun after slaying you first (in lore) dragon.

where.desc: Lydia has some lines of dialogue with Lucien and Inigo using her original (vanilla Skyrim) voice.
where.title: Notes

creator: Roadhouse699 & LMG Wilson

req.misc: have completed Dragon Rising

overview: Aviendha is a follower inspired by the lore of The Wheel of Time series of books; she is a "Maiden of the Spear". See the wiki or Nexus page for more info.

howTo.text: Aviendha will spawn west of the Riverwood bridge. After each few days of travel with her, if you have completed Dragon Rising, she will start a new part of her main questline.

creator: AlmightySE

overview: Introduce followers Katana, Megara and Shale to the world of Skyrim. The trio has an associated questline but also dynamically interacts with their surroundings. See the wiki or Nexus page for more info.

howTo.text: You can find Katana at the Winking Skeever in Solitude.

creator: Anna Garcia & Kat B

overview: Jesper is a Whiterun guard doing his best, but his fellows don't seem to take him seriously; looking at the wooden sword there...  See the wiki or Nexus page for more info.

howTo.text: You can recruit Jesper at Bannered Mare in Whiterun.[\\n]You can marry Jesper but there isn't a special romance questline.[\\n]Jesper doesn't have as much custom dialogue as the other dedicated follower mods (The mod is still a work in progress).
howTo.title: How to Start & Notes

where.desc: Two tomes are available to learn how to summon Jesper to your location: one behind the counter at the Bannered Mare, the other to the left of Dragonsreach on a rock with a wooden sword.
where.title: Tomes Locations

creator: Jared Alexander

overview: Rescue a young timid maid and watch her slowly become a fierce warrior. See the wiki or Nexus page for more info.

howTo.text: Once entering Dead Man's Drink in Falkreath a quest will start to go rescue her at Bannermist Tower (or you can simply go there without needing to enter the inn).

where.desc: Melana is trainable as a melee fighter; she is dynamical and will improve with time.
where.title: Notes

notes.text: You can train Melana by sparring with her, however this will be interpreted as an aggression by most other followers who will then attack her; you can either try to spar with her without such followers around or simply let her improve by fighting actual enemies. She might also kill you if she's too strong (mostly if you give her a too strong weapon).
notes.title: Warnings

creator: DavisionByZero & KiaraRedVA

overview: Adds a brand new quest in which a bearded old trader will teach you about Saturalia and ask your aid to help the people in Skyrim and spread the spirit of Saturalia across the province

howTo.text: Talk to Niklas the Trader outside Dawnstar, north of Windward Ruins.

notes.text: You don't have to complete or start the quest to obtain the displayable items; they are all byable from Niklas. At the end of the quest you will be rewarded with a buff of your choice.

creator: jayserpa

overview: The Crimson Dirks might be in hiding, but they've been bandits all their lives. They tend to leave trails of destruction. The quest integrates the Alternative Armor - Daedric Mail, Dwarven Mail, Ebony Plate, Elven Hunter, Stalhrim Fur, Steel Soldier and Studded Dragonscale Creations.

howTo.text: To start the main quest you need to find and read the bounty letter for the Crimson Dirks. Near each of the locations you'd eventually end up fighting one of the Crimson Dirks, you'll find a dead bounty hunter with said letter and the Crimson Dirks' dossiers; or you can search for a Bounty Dispatch Strongbox at Castle Dour (Solitude) or the Penitus Oculatus Outpust (Dragon Bridge). The main quest branches into the various Alternative Armors Creations' quests.

where.desc: The various sub-quests can be started by talking to innkeepers in Falkreath (Elven Hunter), Dragon's Bridge (Steel Soldier), Windhelm (Daedric Mail), Nightgate Inn (Studded Dragonscale), Ivarstead (Dwarven Mail) and Skaal Village in Solstheim (Stalhrim Fur); once you have disposed of the other dirks you will receive a letter for the final confrontation (Ebony Plate).
where.title: Creations' Quests

notes.text: This mod does not add any display; all the alternative armors given as rewards by the dirks are enchanted and not displayable. The displayable variants can be found in random loot or crafted with the necessary perks.

creator: Epic Crab

overview: Sir Areldur, a Knight of the Nine fearing Thalmor prosecution for the order's Talos worship, hid the Crusader's Relics north. Take up the cause of the Knights and reunite the Relics once more! This mod overhauls the quest from the Divine Crusader Creation.

howTo.text: Next to every relic from this mod is a journal and a note that will begin the quest. The author of the mod recommends starting with the place near the Tower Stone in Winterhold.

notes.text: The displays from this mod expand those of the Divine Crusader Creation. The mod's armor and weapons are the same as the version of Legacy of the Dragonborn, as such, this mod's pieces will count towards the completion of the LotD's version of the quest which has specific quest markers you will lose. [\\n]This mod is supposed to be played as a scavenger-hunt by using the hints from the journal of Sir Areldur and the Thalmor's Orders and does not have its own marked quest. Completing either this quest mod or the LotD's version (or a mixture of the two) will complete the Creation's displays.

creator: Tate Taylor

overview: A complete overhaul for the Lord's Mail Creation now set in Cyrodiil. This mod removes the original quest by placing the Lord's Mail on a boss at the end of Morihaus' Refuge.

howTo.text: The dungeon is situated in Cyrodiil, east of Bruma and near Grom's Pass.

notes.text: The Lord's Mail you obtain from this mod is the Minor version. You can obtain the "Lord's Mail" through the Legacy of the Dragonborn questline; both share the same display and the same replica.

creator: Jelidity

overview: In the aftermath of the Red Year, worship of the Tribunal has been replaced by the Reclamation. Yet the strands of memory linger on Solstheim, the chant of ALMSIVI muttered by rebel priests and devotees of the old ways.

howTo.text: In order to start the mod's questline read the "Heretic Dossier: Blacksmith's Confessional" at the Temple in Raven Rock in Solstheim.

notes.text: Tuxborn uses GTheGenerous's Voiced Narrative mod to expand the NPCs' dialogues.[\\n]Some items are already distributed through the world.

creator: Kris Takahashi

overview: You have been cordially invited to dinner and drinks at Bloodchill Manor. As an honored guest, you are encouraged to come early and mingle with the other attendees. When you are ready to feast, ask the house waiter for a menu. Come for the dinner, stay for the drinks.

howTo.text: You will receive the Dinner Invitation by a courier, read it to begin the quest.

where.desc: Tuxborn uses GTheGenerous's Voiced Narrative mod to expand the NPCs' dialogues.
where.title: Notes

creator: Elianora & Kris Takahashi

overview:
Daedroths are large reptilian Daedra that commonly serve the Daedric Prince Molag Bal. 
You will be able to encounter several of them in the wilds.

notes.text: Daedroths are randomly encountered in open areas and some caves similarly to trolls. They will drop a Spell Tome that teaches you how to summon them (there are 4 leveled versions)
notes.title: Details

creator: 4thUnknown

overview: The dead emerge from the muck in the swamps of Morthal. The more you are splattered with their flesh, the harder it will be to escape. Can you master their power for yourself?

howTo.text: Head to the Summoning Stones in Morthal's swamp and find the Knapsack with the Call of the Marsh Spell Tome; use the spell on a corpse to teleport it to the Stones then wait 8 hours to make it turn into a Bogmort Thrall and speak to it to make it follow you.

notes.text: In case the sacrificed NPC had quest items in their inventory they will be brought to the Strongbox near the knapsack. The Bogmort Thrall doesn't count against your follower limit as it's considered as an animal follower.

creator: opusGlass

overview: Expansion of the Forgotten Names quest involving the gauntler in the Midden Dark.

howTo.text: To properly start the mod's content you will have to decline Velehk's offer. After the battle you will be able to craft a special staff at the Atronach Forge. Alternatively, you can simply fuse the rings at the Atronach Forge for a different reward.

notes.text: The quest doesn't appear in your journal. The rings needed to activate the gauntlet have been placed on the 4 missing apprentices. The mod does not add displyable items, however you will miss one if you decide to decline Velehk's offer.

creator: SomethingObscure

overview: The Court Wizard of Solitude, Sybille Stentor, has a secret. It's up to you to investigate her deeds and decide on her fate. Will you keep her secret, demand she stops her activities, report her to the authorities, or end her life?

howTo.text: There is no real "quest" to start; however, talking to the cook or Melaran at the Blue Palace will hint the player to look for clues in Solitude to reveal the true nature of the Court Wizard.

creator: TheOscar0

overview: Help Rune of the Thieves Guild search for information on his past and discover what happened to his parents.

howTo.text: Speak to Rune in the Ragged Flagon and ask him about his name.

creator: TheOscar0

req.misc: have completed the Thieves Guild main questline

overview: Jaree-Ra in Solitude has a plan to set up a shipwreck. The mod allows for more approaches to the quest "Lights Out!".

howTo.text: In order to unlock the various paths you will need to unveil Jaree-Ra's link with the Maraudeers; in order to do so you will have to search for proof at their hideout (Broken Oar Grotto); ask Ahtar the executioner and warden of the Castle Dour Dungeon for a pointer to such place.

notes.text: The mod expands the quest Lights Out! (Talk to Jaree-Ra in Solitude to pick it up) allowing for more paths including killing Jaree-Ra, reporting him or even doubling down to join him in his "deed" with a renewed attitude.[\\n]Depending on you choices, Jaree-Ra may become your follower.

creator: Parapets

overview: This mod turns the Destroy the Dark Brotherhood quest into a Penitus Oculatus questline. Hunt down all the members of the faction and conquer their sanctuary!

howTo.text: The questline starts the same as vanilla's Destroy the Dark Brootherhood: punch Astrid.

where.desc: At the end of the main questline the Penitus Oculatus will take over the Brotherhood's Sanctuary and you will be able to aid them in their efforts against the thalmor.
where.title: Notes

notes.text: Some dialogue from main characters is unvoiced at the moment; it will be silent.[\\n]The questline will not unlock the Dark Brotherhood display in the Dragonborn Gallery.
notes.title: Warnings

creator: RoadHouse699

overview: A small bundle of quests to improve your experience at the Bards College; meet new bards and help them with their songs.

howTo.text: There are 4 quests that can be started by talking to following NPCs at the Bards College in Solitude: Delric Merick, Aia Arria, Jorn and Viarmo.[\\n]These are more or less simple fetch quests.

name.full: More to do in the Bards College

creator: Betalille

req.misc: have completed Tending the Flames

overview: Greatly expanded Markarth's Cidhna Mine and improved related quest along with new characters and available followers.

howTo.text: To properly start the additional content you'll need to complete the Forsworn Conspiracy and start No One Escapes Cidhna Mine!

where.desc: The Mine can be accessed freely and is situated in the southern part of Markarth. It's used as prison.
where.title: The Mine

notes.text: The Forsworn Conspiracy will start automatically after witnessing the attack in Markarth's market. 4 followers are available depending on your choices during the escape.

creator: Nerd of Prey

overview: An alternative route to the Ebony Mail, this time no friend needs to be sacrificed! After claiming the artifact you may be deemed unworthy by Boethia, who will send someone to take it from you.

howTo.text: To begin, speak with the Dark Elf, Rudin Filaro, at the Braidwood Inn in Kynesgrove.

creator: MadAborModding

overview: An alternative route to the Ring of Namira; you will be able to dismantle the cult without losing out on the rewards and also have a boss fight.

howTo.text: During the quest The Taste of Death you will have a couple of opportunities to antagonize the cult; if you do and read Eola's Journal the alternate quest will begin.

where.desc: To begin The Taste of Death ask for rumors to the innkeeper at the Silver-Blood Inn in Markarth about the Hall of the Dead; you will then need to speak with brother Verulus (can also be done without indication of the innkeeper).
where.title: The Taste of Death

creator: MadAborModding

overview: A new complete set of silver armor and weapons along with a full set of necromancer themed summons await you in the depths of Heroes Rest Crypt.

howTo.text: You can find the dungeon "Heroes Rest Crypt" next to the area surrounding Dayspring Canyon and Stendarr's Beacon. At the end of the dungeon you will find all the new equipment and spells.

notes.text: Variants of the armors and weapons can be crafted at a forge if you have the originals.[\\n]The mod introduces many necromantic spells, including some "summon army" spells.

creator: wooden knight

overview:
Help Duarelm find the Wind Scour Temple, a Blade temple, and start rebuilding the Blades and the Dragonguard archives in Hammerfell.
The mod is part of Betalille's Quests Bundle.

howTo.text: Head to a settlement called Vulstad in the Alik'r Desert. On the roof of one of the houses, you will find an old man called Duarelm. Talk to him.

creator: Betalille

overview:
An unknown initiate has come to you asking for help in reintroducing the Dark Brotherhood in Hammerfell.
The mod is part of Betalille's Quests Bundle.

howTo.text: An "Unknown Initiate" will be on a small island, to the north of the Dawnstar Sanctuary. Talk to her, it will launch the introduction quest.

creator: Betalille

req.misc: have completed Hail Sithis

overview:
Discover the newly opened Cyrodilic Collections in the Alik'r Desert of Hammerfell, a small association that focuses on retrieving stolen argonian heritage.
The mod is part of Betalille's Quests Bundle.

howTo.text: Head northwest of the Ben Erai city to find a small house; enter the building and talk to the argonian lady, she will ask you to work for her.

creator: Betalille

overview:
Head back to the Alik'r Desert and help the Ash'abah, fight off necromancers and help the citizens of a new village: Salas Kazas.
The mod is part of Betalille's Quests Bundle.

howTo.text: One quest is in Ben Erai, three in the new village Salas Kazas, one is north-west of the Lantern of the North, one is in the Retching Netch in Solstheim (but only once you finished the main quest of the Grey Cowl) and the final one can only be completed after you finish the quests with the Ash'abah, the ancient library and the necromancers. The final quest can be started after talking to the Ash'abah Honai, once all the required quests are finished. A crime system and prison are introduced.

creator: Betalille

overview:
Join hands with a Lamia to fight against her sister gone rogue. Recruit her for your next adventures and learn to summon Spectral Lamias.
The mod is part of Betalille's Quests Bundle.

howTo.text: North of the Ancient Alik'r Palace in the Alik'r Desert, you should find two small houses in ruins with a Lamia somewhere in the area. Talk to her and start the quest.

notes.text: The Lamia follower Is treated more like a creature follower than a standard one. Her equipment cannot be changed.

creator: Betalille
